column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE EXCISE ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 52)

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

column2: This Act may be cited as the Excise (Amendment)
Section  30  of  the  Excise  Ordinance  (Chapter  52)

column1: (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby

column2: in subsection (1) by the substitution for the words
“Every  person  who  manufactures  or  sells  any
excisable  article  under  a  licence”  of  the  words
“Every  person  who  imports,  exports,  transports,
manufactures, sells, possess or stores any excisable
article under a licence, permit or pass;
in the marginal note to that section for the words
“certain licensees” of the words “holder of a licence,
permit or pass”.
Section  32  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column2: prescribing  the  types  of  security  features  to  be

article 
is 
imported,  exported, 
transported,

levying charges for  issuing of the security features
referred to in paragraph (ja) to be affixed on any
excisable  article  when  such  excisable  article  is
